timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Hello, my name is K-Non. I want to talk about language. Language has been a very influential
part of my development. Language is two main characteristics. One is language as a communication
tool and the other is language as a cultural carrier. Language is unique to a people and so different
people have different experiences that are unique to them and feel a cultural resonance to whatever
that experience might be. If a lightning was to take a place and it's for the first time, they would
have marked it with the sound that they feel is relevant to whether it was positive, negative or neutral.
So then that word is recorded in the community's linguistic memory bank and so that's how language develops
over time. Different people will record words in their memory bank in different tones and
different feelings. That's where language as a cultural carrier comes on. There are always new events in the
world and new scenarios and new interactions and therefore it is a growing living thing language. For me, language as a
cultural carrier was something that I became aware of when I left my country and came to North America,
having lost my ability to communicate, I started to wonder what effect language was having on me and this is
when I started to try to learn more about language as a cultural carrier. So the country that I come from
took language very seriously. A country of incredible eloquence Somali is known as the Nation of Poets. So
language is something that we're fully aware of. We were fortunate even though we fought colonialism and of
course waged the longest anti-colonial war in the history of Africa. This country did not allow for any schools
speaking in a colonial language to teach the children of Somalia. Therefore learning ourselves in our own language
with all the charm of everything history has recorded about our experiences and therefore developing as full human beings.
And that's why I think language is a very important and monumental role, a thing in everyone's life and
that's language not just as communication but language as a cultural carrier. My name is Canaan and that's
my hundred and twenty seconds. Peace!

youtube_description:
Friends We Love
a little show about BIG things

120 Seconds w/ K'naan

Somali MC & musician K'naan shares his views on language as not only a tool for communication but also as a cultural carrier and its influence in the way we view ourselves and our surrounding environment.
